edits.text: 木 is currently used for ‘tree’. An oracle-bone phrase, 埶(藝)木, has been interpreted as referring to planting trees, but the rubbing has not been checked, so this report does not confirm a historical use meaning ‘tree’. It also does not establish whether ‘tree’ or ‘wood’ came first.
